short_description: Consumer-facing lifestyle trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for gym- or sports-club-attendance tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing activity trait describing a cautious inherited signal related to regular gym or sports-club attendance relative to the current local reference panel.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with a tendency toward regular attendance at a gym or sports club, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: This is a cautious panel-relative activity-participation signal, not a direct readout of how often you currently attend a gym or sports club. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a direct readout of current gym attendance, sports participation, fitness level, or motivation.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.
Real-world gym or sports-club attendance depends strongly on access, money, schedule, local culture, health, injury history, and personal motivation.
This trait should not be used as a commitment, discipline, or athletic-potential judgment.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
